name: artur-plugins
description: Engineering skills for architecture, governed audits, source-backed documentation, repository instructions, prompts, writing, operations, handover, Agent Skill creation and evaluation, and Claude/Codex plugin authoring and installation management.

interface.longDescription: Engineering workflows for code review, debugging, agent-session diagnosis, architecture, implementation planning, audit tickets, project recovery, codebase documentation, repository guidance, Agent Skill creation/evaluation, and Claude Code/Codex plugin management. Use them with accessible project files and tools. Read-only review and planning do not require audit setup; audit lifecycle commands require Python 3.10+ and a writable project workspace. The bundled local MCP server is optional and must be configured separately. Installation starts no hooks, services, or servers.
capabilities: Debug failures to their root cause
defaultPrompt: Review this repository for confirmed defects and regressions without editing files.
Create an implementation-ready architecture and change plan for this codebase.
Inspect this Claude Code or Codex plugin for packaging and compatibility issues.
